about: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on the uniform K4 EXL3 pack (as nemotron_h-exl3-k4: every trunk Linear exl3m_k4, the head exl3m_k6, the rest from the BF16 checkpoint as stored) with NVIDIA's LiLiCorr block drafter in place of the MTP module (L298): build with --drafter lilicorr DIR. The target's MTP module is omitted (pulsar.mtp_present false); the drafter's ModelOpt NVFP4 Linears are written nvfp4, its other tensors as stored (shard `drafter`). The trunk rows are scoped to block `layers` so they do not reach the MTP tensors; the top-level norm_f is named. The vision tower (L331): as stored, BF16, its LayerNorm weights and biases f32.
